article.headline: Siena takes down Fairfield 68-64
article.description: — Justice Shoats had 23 points in Siena's 68-64 victory against Fairfield on Thursday.
article.story: ALBANY, N.Y. -- — Justice Shoats had 23 points in Siena's 68-64 victory against Fairfield on Thursday. Shoats added five rebounds, five assists, and three steals for the Saints (14-16, 9-10 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Gavin Doty added 12 points while shooting 3 for 12 (0 for 3 from 3-point range) and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line while he also had nine rebounds. Brendan Coyle shot 3 of 9 from the field, including 3 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 5 from the line to finish with 12 points. The Stags (11-19, 7-12) were led by Prophet Johnson and Braden Sparks with 20 points apiece. Both teams play again on Saturday. Siena visits Manhattan and Fairfield hosts Quinnipiac. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
